prompt: A medieval battlefield at the moment of divine judgment. Three armored soldiers and a horned beast, from opposing armies, are all struck down at once by a sweeping wave of searing white-gold holy radiance crossing the field; their bodies arch backward and crumple, swords and a shield flung from their hands, all four figures fully visible and the same size. Crimson blood on trampled earth. The only source of light is the blinding white-gold divine radiance pouring from a rift in the storm-gray clouds above. The background is a war-torn field under a dark overcast sky.
